description: A tray of ration samples one day past 'discard' and a franchise smile you have to supply yourself. Push them at Ration Nine, then work the crowds at the Marquee and Battery Square. Do not eat the samples. 10₵.
name: Free Samples

objectives.desc: Hand out samples at Ration Nine
emotes: {who} thrusts a sample cup at a passerby and chirps 'New recipe!' with zero conviction.
{who} arranges the tray to hide the ones that are visibly moving.
{who} takes a sample cup back off someone who was clearly going to steal it.
{who} works the Marquee, pressing samples on anyone who slows down for even a second.
{who} calls 'Free! Free!' under the lights, and a small hungry crowd forms fast.
{who} refills the tray from a bag they were absolutely not supposed to bring.

objectives.desc: Clear the tray at Battery Square
emotes: {who} unloads the last samples on Battery Square, tray finally, blessedly empty.
{who} hands off the dregs to a kid who wasn't going to take no for an answer.
{who} sets the empty tray down, stomach growling, having not eaten a single one. Rules are rules.
